thread:
Nina (Support): Escalation T-12801: trial tenant HorizonML seeing sustained 504s from embeds after SSO provisioning. Their validation run is active; renewal in 6 days.
Raj (CS): Can you summarize impact, mitigations tried, and primary contact? We need a 1-2 sentence customer note + internal comms plan.
Nina (Support): Impact: embed success fell from ~95% to ~20% over last hour. Logs show repeated "504 gateway timeout -> kvcache eviction -> fallback loop". Tried: restarted pool, bumped timeouts, no change. Contact: Eli Stone (eli@horizonml.ai), PST.
Maya (Solutions): Short-term mitigation: pin tenant to a short-lived dedicated burst pool and use legacy embed model to reduce memory churn. Also increase tenant cache TTL. I can stage routing change; Ops to provision pool.
Theo (Ops): I can provision a 2-hour burst (1xA10G) if AE approves reserved usage. Will run smoke test and post validation curl.
Raj (CS): Nina please draft the customer-facing blurb (2 sentences + ETA). Also indicate if we should offer a trial credit. I'll coordinate outreach once Ops confirms.
Nina (Support): Draft for CS: "Hi Eli - were seeing elevated embed timeouts after your SSO change. Were applying a temporary mitigation (route to a dedicated pool) within the next 90 minutes and will update you by 15:30 PST. Apologies for the disruption; we will follow up with an RCA."
Raj (CS): Tweak: cc cs@redwood.com and offer a 10% trial credit for impacted runs. Scheduling 15:30 bridge for validation.
incident-bot: Incident bridge created -> https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-12801 (auto). Use for the 15:30 sync.
Theo (Ops): Provisioned burst-horizon-1. Smoke test: 20/20 success, median latency 160ms.
Nina (Support): Verified repeated calls from support console: 100% success, latency ~170ms. Sending Raj the draft to send. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Raj (CS): Outreach sent to Eli (cc cs@redwood.com). Internal comms checklist: 1) notify AE + renewal owner, 2) ops mitigation window 2h, 3) offer 10% trial credit, 4) open RCA and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High.
Maya (Solutions): Recommend follow-up engineering task: auto-model-pin for trial tenants and an alert if embed error rate >15% for 30m. I'll file a ticket.
Raj (CS): After the bridge paste any direct customer feedback here so CS can update renewal risk. Thanks team.
